findings.title: Double-quoting the placeholder does not make the command safe against a slug/path containing ", $ or backticks; no test covers these.
findings.evidence: .claude/agents/idea-planner.md:9-10 and agent-workflows/idea-planner-agent.md:24-25 (as the reviewer cited them). $/backtick content is live shell syntax inside double quotes (command substitution risk); an embedded " breaks the quoting outright.
findings.consequence: Not a blocker for the round-3 finding as scoped (space/apostrophe), but a residual gap if the owner wants the command hardened against arbitrary slug content.
